# What matters most to young people?

## Harvard Youth Poll

>This poll of 2,024 18-to-29-year-olds was organized with undergraduate students from the Harvard Public Opinion Project (HPOP) and supervised by John Della Volpe, Director of Polling. Ipsos Public Affairs collected data using the KnowledgePanel^[https://www.ipsos.com/en-us/solutions/public-affairs/knowledgepanel]. 

<https://iop.harvard.edu/youth-poll/53rd-edition-fall-2026#toc-4>

---

>KnowledgePanel provides probability-based samples with an “organic representation” of the study population for measurement of public opinions, attitudes, and behaviors. Interviews were conducted in English and Spanish between September 30 and October 7, 2026.

<https://iop.harvard.edu/youth-poll/53rd-edition-fall-2026#toc-4>

- Better off financially than they are now
- Worse off financially than they are now

### How serious a threat, if at all, do you think each of the following is to your long-term financial security?

- Immigration increasing competition for jobs
- The wealth and power of billionaires
- Artificial intelligence (AI) replacing jobs
- Government spending and the national debt

---

### How serious a threat, if at all, do you think each of the following is to your long-term financial security?

- Trade wars and barriers to global trade
- The power of large corporations
- Rising prices and the cost of living

---

![@UnknownUnknown-vw](https://iop.harvard.edu/sites/default/files/styles/responsive_image_2000/public/media/image/DiZnQ-6.-how-serious-a-threat-if-at-all-do-you-think-each-of-the-following-is-to-your-long-term-financial-security-the-power-of-large-corporations-.webp)

---

### How important will each of the following issues be in determining your vote in the 2026 midterm elections?

- The cost of living
- Corruption in government
- U.S. involvement in wars and conflicts overseas
- Free and fair elections
- Immigration enforcement and deportations

---

### How important will each of the following issues be in determining your vote in the 2026 midterm elections?

- Trade with other countries
- Abortion
- Climate and the environment
- Drug trafficking
- Transgender issues

## Yale Youth Poll

>Results from survey of 3,429 registered voters, including 2,008 voters aged 18-34, enabling a comparison of young voters to the electorate as a whole. Full results available on the Spring 2026 Results page.

-- https://youthpoll.yale.edu

### When it comes to deciding your vote, which of the following issues is most important to you?

## {.scrollable}

>Voters care least about Israel and Palestine (28%), Ukraine and Russia (27%), China (27%), artificial intelligence (24%), acceptance of gay people (22%), and acceptance of transgender people (19%), despite the prominence of these issues in the news.

# Resources

## About

This talk was produced using [Quarto](https://quarto.org), using the [RStudio](https://posit.co/products/open-source/rstudio/)
Integrated Development Environment (IDE), version 2026.10.0.233.

The source files are in R and R Markdown, then rendered to HTML using the
[revealJS](https://revealjs.com) framework.
The HTML slides are hosted in a [GitHub repo](https://github.com/psu-psychology/psych-490-data-viz-2026-fall) and served by GitHub pages at:
<https://psu-psychology.github.io/psych-490-data-viz-2026-fall>
